description: Khagolshastra (Sanskrit for astronomy) is a team from India building a “weather forecast for the Moon”: clear sunlight and Earth-contact verdicts for south pole landing sites, using real NASA SPICE and LOLA data, tested on Chandrayaan-3. Our plan and designs are ready. We’re looking for Python/data skills, front-end (JS, D3/Three.js), UI/UX design and a presenter. Curious beginners welcome! Join us to work with real NASA data on an idea that stands out.
